cohere-embed-v3-english.reason: Azure AI Foundry serves Cohere's Embed v3 English (embed-english-v3.0, 512-token window, $0.10/1M on Azure per Microsoft Marketplace); same model as cohere/embed-english-v3.0.

phi-4.reason: Azure AI Foundry serves Microsoft's Phi-4, the 14B reasoning-focused small language model (Hugging Face microsoft/phi-4, Dec 2024); the index has only phi-4-mini and phi-4-multimodal-instruct, no Phi-4 entry, so defer rather than link the mini.

phi-4-reasoning-plus.reason: Microsoft's Phi-4-reasoning-plus, the Phi-4 reasoning model with additional reinforcement learning for higher accuracy (per the Microsoft Foundry catalog and coverage); a separate checkpoint the index has no entry for, so defer.
